# 18pace

> Free half marathon pace calculator with real race-day strategy. Built by an actual sub-1:50 runner. Get exact per-km splits, mile splits, and printable pace bands for any target finish time.

## Core Tools

- [Half Marathon Pace Calculator](https://18pace.com/): Calculate exact per-kilometer and per-mile splits for any half marathon target time (1:30, 1:40, 1:50, 2:00, 2:10+)
- [Sub-1:50 Strategy Guide](https://18pace.com/): Real race-day strategy from an actual sub-1:50 finisher — negative splits, heart rate drift, gel nutrition
- [5K Split Table](https://18pace.com/): Automatic 5K, 10K, 15K, 20K, and finish splits for any target time

## Key Information

- **Free to use**: No login required, no paywall on core functionality
- **Built by an actual runner**: Every strategy recommendation comes from real race experience, not generic AI content
- **Real race data**: Negative split pacing, gel timing at km 8-9 and km 13-14, heart rate drift patterns
- **Multiple target times**: Sub-1:30, Sub-1:40, Sub-1:50, Sub-2:00, Sub-2:10+

## Use Cases

- Runners targeting sub-1:50 half marathon finish
- Runners needing printable pace bands for race day
- Coaches building training plans around specific pace targets
- Runners analyzing negative split strategies

## Technical Details

- **Type**: Web application (static HTML + Tailwind CSS + JavaScript)
- **Pricing**: Free
- **Login required**: No
- **Mobile-friendly**: Yes (responsive design)
